create_missing_persons.description: Create a person for a distinct ID that has none. Off by default, because a distinct ID that does not match your app's identify call creates a person that never gets a push.

dry_run.description: Check every row and report what would fail, without storing anything. Run this first and fix the failed rows before importing.

id.description: A unique integer value identifying this integration.

import_id.description: A new UUID for each batch. Send the same value when you retry that batch, so a retried batch can be recognized as a repeat.

subscriptions.description: Up to 1000 devices to register on this push channel. List a person once per device.

device_token.description: The token of one device. An APNs channel takes the hex APNs device token. A Firebase channel takes the FCM registration token. Expo push tokens are not accepted.

distinct_id.description: The person's distinct ID in this project: the ID your app passes to `identify`.
